# Read Primitives — String Substring

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

String substring extraction

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Substring extraction */ SELECT c_custkey, SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 3) AS country_code FROM customer LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def string_substring_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """String substring extraction."""
    return (
        ctx.get_table("customer")
        .select(ctx.col("c_custkey"), ctx.col("c_phone").str.slice(0, 3).alias("country_code"))
        .limit(100)
    )
```
